title: Settings
subtitle: Shape Orbital Vision around your system.

language.label: Language
language.dialogDescription: Orbital Vision will update immediately. You can change this later in Settings.

graphics.label: Graphics quality
graphics.description: Balance visual fidelity and power usage.

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.description: Limit non-essential movement and camera transitions.

units.label: Units
units.description: Choose how distance, speed and weather are displayed.

time.label: Time display
time.description: Choose UTC and local-time presentation for mission timestamps.

camera.label: Default camera
camera.description: Choose the opening view for the Earth workspace.

backgroundSync.label: Background synchronization
backgroundSync.description: Keep provider data current while the application is running.

credentials.label: NASA API credential
credentials.description: Stored securely in Windows Credential Manager. The key is never returned to the interface.
credentials.error: The credential operation could not be completed.

cache.label: Local cache
cache.description: Live data will remain available during network interruptions.

updates.label: Application updates
updates.description: Installed version {{version}}. Check for securely signed updates.
updates.availableTitle: An Orbital Vision update is ready
updates.availableDescription: Install it now, or continue working and return to it later.
updates.checkErrorDescription: The current version will keep working. Check your connection and try again.
updates.criticalDescription: This version is no longer supported. The signed update will install automatically to preserve security and data compatibility.

errors.checkFailed: The update service cannot be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.
errors.installFailed: The signed package could not be installed. No files were changed; try again.
